visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit airport terminal check-in area. A woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a pink jacket over a white hoodie and denim shorts, walks slowly towards the camera while pulling a large, light-pink suitcase. She maintains eye contact with the camera and talks casually. (2) The woman shifts to an extremely animated state. She jumps slightly, clasps her hands together under her chin with a wide smile, and then points vigorously at the camera while speaking with intense facial expressions. Her body language is exaggerated as she leans forward and waves her hands to emphasize her excitement. (3) The woman suddenly stops all movement and her facial expression turns deadpan and neutral. She stands still, looking directly into the lens with a flat gaze, creating a stark contrast to the previous energetic phase. (4) The woman is back in the airport terminal, standing next to the pink suitcase. She points down at the suitcase with her index finger, smiling professionally. The lighting is bright and even studio-style airport lighting. (5) A brief cutaway shows the woman indoors, sitting on the floor next to the pink suitcase. She demonstrates the front-opening feature by unzipping a flap and pulling out a white cloth. The suitcase is filled with neatly packed items, including food packages and clothing. (6) Returning to the airport, the woman pushes the suitcase across the polished floor. She looks at the camera while walking, talking rapidly with an enthusiastic smile and giving a thumbs-up. Graphic overlays showing different suitcase sizes (20, 25, 28 inches) appear at the bottom of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a calm conversational exchange between a male voice off-camera and a female voice. The female speaker has a clear, youthful timbre. Background noise consists of a soft airport hum and distant indistinct chatter. There is no background music in this opening phase. (2) A significant vocal inflection occurs as the female speaker transitions into high-energy shouting. Her pitch becomes much sharper and higher, and the speech rate accelerates to an extremely fast pace. She expresses intense excitement with frequent rising intonations. No BGM is present, emphasizing the raw vocal performance. (3) The vocal energy abruptly drops. The female speaker delivers a short, deadpan phrase in a low-arousal, monotone voice. The sudden silence from her previous shouting creates a comedic 'chill' effect. Ambient room tone remains low. (4) A soft, upbeat electronic BGM track fades in with a steady synthesizer melody. The female speaker switches to a professional, persuasive promotional tone. Every few seconds, a light digital 'ding' sound effect emphasizes key points. The sound of a suitcase zipper being opened is briefly heard. (5) The female voice increases in pitch and speed towards the end, asking repetitive questions like 'Right? Right?' to seek validation. The BGM maintains a consistent tempo until the very end, where a final hard cut brings the audio to silence.
